description: Wukong board ROM boot program: LED0 blink at ~1 Hz and "CM:WUKONG\r\n" UART callhome banner. 73-instruction infinite loop, no CALL/RETURN. Transcribed from WUKONG_NUC_PROGRAM in hardware/boot_rom.py. See docs/wukong-boot.md for the NULL_CAP standalone problem this solves.

capabilities.name: LED0
capabilities.note: LED_DEV  Inform GT (NS slot 3, MMIO 0x40000000, RW)

capabilities.name: UART_TX
capabilities.note: UART_DEV Inform GT (NS slot 2, MMIO 0x40000014, RW — R needed for STATUS poll)

author: Church Machine
